idea: Shapes (Friday school readiness, long 2:40 learning song) in the BACKYARD: a big red foam circle bounces up right beside Baby Jimmy's face ('Boing! Wow! Look! A big red circle!'); chorus 'Circle, square, triangle, star! Shapes, shapes – here they are! … Clap with me – you're a star!'; each verse starts with a new shape popping up beside him – red circle (draw a circle in the air), blue square (one, two, three, four sides; clap four times), green triangle (one, two, three sides; pointy roof with the arms), yellow star (a star like the one on his onesie; wiggle your fingers); clap break; review row of all four shapes and the question 'Which one is the star? Hmm?' (2 s pause) – 'The yellow star! Yay!'; loop: the hook framing with the red circle, bye-bye wave.
title: Wow! A Big Red Circle! 🔴 Shapes Song with Baby Jimmy | Nursery Rhymes & Kids Songs | Crayon Babies
description:
Boing! A big red circle bounces right up beside Baby Jimmy! 🔴 Sing along with Baby Jimmy in his sunny backyard and learn four shapes – circle, square, triangle and star – as each new shape pops up beside him.

🎬 What happens in this video:
😮 "Boing! Wow! Look! A big red circle!"
🔴 Circle – round and round! Draw a circle in the air with Jimmy!
🟦 Square – one, two, three, four sides! Clap four times!
⛺ Triangle – one, two, three sides! Make a pointy roof with your arms!
⭐ Star – a star just like the one on Jimmy's onesie! Wiggle your fingers!
👏 Clap break – clap, clap, clap your hands with Jimmy!
🤔 "Which one is the star?" – can you point to it?
👋 Bye bye, friends! You're a star!

📚 Kids learn: shapes • circle • square • triangle • star • a square has four sides • a triangle has three sides • English words: round, sides, clap, shine

🎶 Voices only: children singing, humming and clapping with a soft hand drum – no other musical instruments.

🎵 Lyrics (chorus):
Circle, square, triangle, star!
Shapes, shapes – here they are!
Circle, square, triangle, star!
Clap with me – you're a star!

A fun sing-along shapes song for toddlers and preschoolers – draw, clap, point and dance along with Baby Jimmy to learn the circle, the square, the triangle and the star. A cappella children's song with voices, claps and a hand drum.

Kids songs • Nursery rhymes • Shapes song • Learn shapes for toddlers • Learn English for kids • Toddler learning • Preschool learning • Kids cartoon • Sing-along songs
